constraints.true_to_size: Direct true-to-size statement or explicit usual-size versus ordered-size equality is required.
constraints.no_signal: Use when direction relative to the size grid or usual size is not established; fits well or sat perfectly alone is insufficient.

signal_explicitness.constraint: none is required when fit_label is no_signal

user_action.constraint: kept_ordered_size requires an explicit action such as kept, collected, purchased, or wears

constraints.low: No usable direction or only a bare fit claim.
constraints.high: Explicit usual-size comparison or at least two independent supporting elements.

research_role.abstention: same decision rule for the primary baseline and proposed method
